complete_records: Each records.jsonl line has call index and the unchanged complete ObservedStep::Event/Terminal wire; no admission elision, clocks converted or expected filling. Original complete available CaptureStepError/typed compiler failure is in errors.jsonl on failure.
value: final.json contains whole copied owner snapshot, actual raw root ref/resolved nominal IDs and separately interpreted whole named nominal tree with exact field ordering. It does not contain a private full-trace oracle.

success.checks: checks.json.passed=true, empty errors, actual Terminal and Halted result plus full typed/prefix/source-site checks. Result actual value is compared only to source-aware frozen named expectation.
success.manifest: File lengths at completion, excluding self; Root separately hashes all complete products.

failure: No synthetic success/final snapshot is created for unavailable owner boundaries. Available original diagnostics/observations are preserved before panic; Root retains actual process streams, partial file set and file-cap/IO errors. A failed case is never a zero-event successful capture or a next test retry.
